name: Isono Ichirouta
source:
A classmate of [url=/c1383]Kenichi's[/url], Sepia is the one person able to outdo his eccentricity. He claims to be able to talk to fairies and often speaks about bizarre subjects, inevitably incurring [url=/c191]Touka's[/url] wrath. A fanatical devotee of Higuchi Saburou, leader of the civil uprising in the past, he resents Kenichi for being a 'dog of the nation'. He is romantically infatuated with Touka's mother, Kyouko.

[From [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sharin_no_Kuni,_Himawari_no_Sh%C5%8Djo]Wikipedia[/url]]
